stance_rationale: This is an architecture/spec draft, not a verifiable alpha package: alpha_scores.parquet, weights.csv, covariance.parquet, IC diagnostics, DSR, Harvey-t, and challenge_note are absent or pending. The draft also contains unresolved PIT/sample/liquidity inconsistencies that cannot be accepted under AX-002 process-honesty and RF-A7 time-series alpha requirements.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: No alpha_scores.parquet exists at qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260517_001 or stage_artifacts/WT_D20260517_001. The package claims 124 effective sig_dates, but no emitted Date x Ticker x score artifact can be inspected.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: Static feature build references Z_Score_Aligned and no NEGATE/FLIP_SIGN pattern was found, but no trained alpha_scores artifact exists for output-level verification.
IC computation is deferred; no ic_history.parquet or Usable_Date <= sig_date audit for realized IC diagnostics exists.
build_features_pool.R routes monthly Factor DB layer through load_month_factors(sd); downstream Forge implementation is still absent.

pit_audit labels regime/overlay as N/A, but feature_allowlist contains Dummy_Regime and macro-derived WT007 features; t-1 regime validation is therefore not N/A and remains unverified in final alpha output.
Factor DB monthly features are claimed to inherit Usable_Date <= sig_date and financial statement lag from load_month_factors.

critical_concerns.description: RF-A7 hard failure: the required alpha_scores.parquet is missing, alpha_vector and confidence_vector are empty, and both stage artifact paths lack the time-series alpha artifact. A design-only draft cannot satisfy Date x Ticker x score validation.

All alpha diagnostics are null or pending: rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey-t, DSR, monotonicity, post-neutralization IC, turnover, and subperiod stability. RF-A1 through RF-A6 cannot be cleared by future Forge promises.
critical_concerns.ax_cite: AX-002; RF-A1; RF-A2; RF-A3; RF-A4; RF-A6

critical_concerns.description: The sample protocol is internally inconsistent: request.json claims 2010 start and about 195 sig_dates, pit_audit reports 148 raw and 124 effective, training_protocol references 112, 124, 134, 644, 608, 895, and 850 in conflicting places. Overlapping 5-window testing with only about 52 test months is not enough to neutralize RF-A3 sample-bias risk.

Liquidity compliance is not proven: build_features_pool.R uses LIQ_THRESHOLD <- 5e7 while the mandate is 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW. No top-decile liquidity or ADV audit is emitted, so RF-A5 and PIT-C10 remain open.

The macro-drop story is inconsistent. The package says macro-prefixed features were dropped, but feature_allowlist still contains WT007 Macro and Macro_Sector rows; pit_audit itself says FRED/ECOS coverage is TBD. That is not a closed PIT-C11 external-series validation.

Charter No Silent Override is incomplete: challenge_note_alpha-research.md, challenge_note.md, artifact_lineage.json, factor_engine_proposal.R, and final alpha_package.json are absent. The file is explicitly marked draft and pending Codex disposition.

AX-007 exemption is asserted, not demonstrated. A single-sleeve long-only top-20 portfolio only escapes the mechanism-break axiom if actual ML sizing is trained and verified; no weights or alpha scores exist.

Academic mechanism support is not sufficient for approval: the claimed You-Zhang 2025 core paper is not accessed, page-level core_reference is missing, and the package imports US/China/ETF evidence into KR top-20 long-only without empirical transfer validation.

Hard portfolio constraints are only specified, not verified. weights.csv is absent, so max_names <= 20, weight_bounds [0, 0.20], sum(weights)=1, turnover < 600%, and schedule time-series behavior cannot be audited.

supporting_arguments: The draft honestly documents several caveats, including request.json date mismatch, projection non-idempotency, and pending Forge gates.
feature_allowlist.csv exists with 644 rows and its sha256 matches the package claim.
Static monthly Factor DB routing appears to use load_month_factors(sd), which partially supports C15 at the feature-construction layer.
The literature review is broad enough to justify a research experiment, but not an alpha-package approval.
unresolved_disputes: Whether this artifact should be judged as an alpha package or downgraded to an architecture proposal.
Whether 5 overlapping walk-forward windows can satisfy subperiod stability under RF-A1/RF-A3 with only about 52 effective test months.
Which feature universe is actually intended: 1044, 1047, 955, 895, 644, 608, or 850.
Whether the remaining WT007 Macro/Macro_Sector rows are PIT-clean and intentionally retained despite the macro-drop claim.
Whether Forge will enforce 2e8 KRW liquidity rather than the observed 5e7 threshold in the feature build.
weakest_assumption: The weakest assumption is that a spec-only DPL architecture with empty alpha vectors and pending Forge metrics can be treated as a valid alpha package before any time-series alpha, IC, weights, liquidity, or constraint evidence exists.
rebuttal_required: Emit alpha_scores.parquet with multi-sig_date Date x Ticker x alpha_score schema and n_sig_dates >= 60.
Emit ic_history.parquet and report rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey t_NW, DSR, monotonicity, sub_stability, and post-neutralization IC.
Emit weights.csv and verify max_names <= 20, weights in [0, 0.20], long-only, sum(weights)=1, turnover < 600% annual, and no single-snapshot schedule.
Reconcile all feature-count and sig_date-count contradictions across request.json, pit_audit.json, dpl_architecture.md, training_protocol.md, and alpha_package_draft.json.
Prove liquidity filter uses 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW, not 5e7 KRW, and report top-decile liquidity.
Provide challenge_note and artifact_lineage with write_json -> record_lineage ordering.
Acquire and cite You-Zhang 2025 core paper with page or section references before claiming direct architectural alignment.
rationalization_red_flags: 10 sig_date sample loss is acceptable cost
single architecture paradigm — exempting hard cap
PIT compliance is PASS under recommended dpl_v1 configuration

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: Only alpha self-validation says PASS_STAGE_2_DELIVERABLES_COMPLETE_PENDING_CODEX_ROUND. Forge and Architect evidence is absent, so AX-008 cannot pass.

alpha_specific_questions: Can the package produce a real alpha_scores.parquet with >= 60 PIT-clean sig_dates before any approval stance is reconsidered?
Does the final training universe enforce 20d TV >= 2e8 KRW, or is the observed 5e7 build threshold leaking into the alpha universe?
Is AX-007 ML-sizing exemption still valid if no trained DPL weights or time-series schedule exist?
Can Harvey t_NW > 2.95 and DSR >= 0.50 survive after counting the 100 planned random-search trials?
